title: Benediction of the Blessed Sacrament / Ofufe Ngozi nke Yukaristia Dị Nsọ

igbo.rubric: As the Blessed Sacrament is being brought to, or placed on the altar, the following or another Eucharistic hymn is sung:
igbo.title: LEENỤ ACHỊCHA NA-ENYE NDỤ ("O Salutaris Hostia")

verses.text:
Leenụ achicha na-enye ndụ,
Nke na-emeghe onuuzo eliugwe,
Ndị iro ji iwe sodo anyị.
Nye anyị ike, nyere anyị aka

Otito okpụ dịịrị Dinwenụ
Onye dị otu, dịrikwo ato,
Onye na-enye ndụ na-enweghị ube,
N'eluigwe, obodo anyị. Amen.

english.rubric: As the Blessed Sacrament is being brought to, or placed on the altar, the following or another Eucharistic hymn is sung.
english.title: O SAVING VICTIM

verses.text:
O Saving Victim opening wide
The gate of heaven to man below;
Our foes on from every side; Your
aid supply, your strength bestow.

To your great name be endless praise.
Immortal Godhead, one in three;
O grant us endless length of days.
In our true native land with thee. Amen.

latin.rubric: The Blessed Sacrament is being brought to, or placed on the altar, the following or another Eucharistic hymn is sung:
latin.title: SALUTARIS

verses.text:
O SALUTARIS hostria,
Quae caeli pandis ostium,
Bella premunt hostillia,
Da robur, fer auxilium.

Uni trinoque Domnio
Sit sempiterna Gloria,
Qui vitam sine termino
Mobis donet in patria. Amen.

Isiala ikpereala,
Ka anyj na-etiri Sakramenti ukwu.
Ma emume nke dị phụrụ,
Nochiri anya aja nke ochie
Okwukwe na-enye
Ihe nke nti na anya enweghị
Ike inye.

Otito na ngozi dịrị Nna na Nwa,
Ngozi, ndụ, ike na ebube
Dirikwara ya;
Otito di elu dikwasiri ya,
Onye si na Nna na Nwa puta.
Amen.

prayer.text: O Dinwenu, onye hapuurụ anyị na Sakramenti nke a dị įtunaanya, ncheta nke ahụhụ gị. nye anyị, anyị na-ario gị nsopurụ nke ihe omimi nke ahu na obara gị, nke ga-eme ka anyi nweta ire nzoputa gị, onye dị ndụ na-achị ebighebi, ebighebi.

english.rubric: Another Eucharistic hymn is sung, for example the following:
english.title: TANTUM ERGO

versicle_response.versicle: You have given your people bread from heaven, (Alleluia)
versicle_response.response: The bread which is full of all goodness. (Alleluia)

prayer.title: Let us Pray
prayer.text: O God, who in this wonderful sacrament has left us a memorial of your passion; help us so to reverence the sacred mysteries of your Body and Blood, that we may always experience in our lives the effects of your redemption: who live and reign for ever and ever. Amen.

latin.rubric: Towards the end of exposition the priest or deacon goes to the altar and kneels. Another Eucharistic hymn is sung, for example the following:
latin.title: TANTUM ERGO

verses.text:
Tantum ergo sacramentum
Veneremur cernui:
Et antiquum documentum.
Novo cedat ritui;
Praestet fides supplementum
Sensuum defetui.

Genitori, Genitoque
Laus et jubilatio,
Salus, honor, virtus quoque
Sit et benedictio:
Procedenti ab utroque
Compar sit laudatio. Amen.

prayer.title: Oremus
prayer.text: Deus, qui nobis sub Sacramento mirabili passionis tuae memoriam reliquisti: tribue, quaesumus, ita nos corporis sanguinis tui sacra mysteria venerari, ut redemptionis tuae fructum in nobis jugiter sentiamus. Qui vivis, &c.

igbo.title: NGOZI DỊIRỊ CHUKWU
praises: Ngozi dịirị Chukwu.
Ngọzị dịirị Aha nsọ nke Chukwu.
Ngọzị dịirị Jesu Kristi bụ Chukwu Ezie burukwa mmadụ ezie
Ngọzị dịirị aha nsọ nke Jesu.
Ngozi dịirị obi Jesu dịkasirị nsọ.
Ngozi dịirị obara ya kacha oke onụ.
Ngozi dịirị Jesu, na Sakramenti dikasiri nsọ nọ n'Olta.
Ngọzị dịirị Chukwu Mmụọ Nsọ onye nkasiobi
Ngozi diiri nne nke Chukwu di ebube Maria dikasirị nsọ.
Ngozi dịirị ịtụ ime ya dị nso na-ejighị njo.
Ngọzị dịirị mbugo n'eluigwe ya dị otito.
Ngọzị dịirị aha nke Maria bụ, Vejin na Nne.
Ngọzị dịirị Josef dịkachara obi ocha bụ di ya.
Ngọzị dịirị Chukwu n'ebe ndị Mmụọoma ya na ndị nsọ ya nọ.

english.title: THE DIVINE PRAISES
praises: Blessed be God.
Blessed be His Holy Name,
Blessed be Jesus Christ, true God and true Man.
Blessed be the name of Jesus
Blessed be His most Sacred Heart.
Blessed be His most Precious Blood.
Blessed be Jesus in the most Holy Sacrament of the Altar.
Blessed be the Holy Spirit, the Paraclete.
Blessed be the great Mother of God, Mary most Holy.
Blessed be Her Holy and Immaculate Conception,
Blessed be Her Glorious Assumption.
Blessed be the Name of Mary, Virgin and Mother.
Blessed be St. Joseph, Her Spouse Most Chaste.
Blessed be God in His Angels and in His Saints.

name.english: Let Us Adore For Ever (Adoremus / Psalm 116/117)

igbo.title: TOBENŲ DINWENŲ ("Adoremus")
intro: Makana o gosiri ebere ya N'ebe anyị nọ;
Otito dirị Nna na Nwa na Mmụọ Nsọ,
Etu ọ dị n'izizi, na kitaa, na Mgbe niile n'uwa ebighebi.

english.title: BENEDICTION REPOSITION PSALM
english.antiphon: Let us adore for ever the Most Holy Sacrament.

psalm.verse_1: O Praise the Lord all you nations; praise Him, all you people.
psalm.verse_2: For His mercy is confirmed upon us; and the truth of the Lord remains for ever.
psalm.doxology: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be world without end. Amen.

english.antiphon_repeat: Let us adore for ever the most Holy Sacrament.

psalm.title: Laudate
psalm.verse_1: Laudate Dominum omnes gentes; laudate eum omnes populi
psalm.verse_2: Quoniam confirmata est super nos misericordia ejus: et veritas Domini manet in aeternum.
psalm.doxology: Gloria Patri, et Filio, et Spiritui Sancto. Sicut erat in principio, et nunc, et semper, in saecula saeculorum. Amen.
